root_cause: Composio Tavily search returned HTTP 432 plan limit despite ACTIVE authorization. Existing canonical producer had DataForSEO fallback but concurrent Tavily requests could repeat blocked requests. Post-merge production authority detected the pre-existing bg-externe-signalen Edge function was absent from supabase/config.toml, so protected main->provider parity failed with SUPABASE_EDGE_FUNCTION_NOT_DECLARED_IN_CONFIG. The first authenticated production v21 run (request 15928) returned HTTP 207: 2/3 successful topics, 19 results, 1 allowed; failing DataForSEO task 40101 already internally retried at provider and may be billable, unlike real no-results code 40102.
change: Use one in-flight probe and bounded per-isolate cooldown for HTTP 432/429 before existing real DataForSEO fallback.
prevention: On the existing scheduler-owned bg-externe-signalen source, share one in-isolate Tavily probe. On provider 432 (plan limit), block repeat Tavily calls for 15 minutes; on 429 for 1 minute. Continue independently evidenced DataForSEO organic fallback, never bypass billing cap, duplicate scheduler, unauthorized egress, RLS or false-green source receipts. Regressions enforce this behavior and source lineage. Register existing bg-externe-signalen in supabase/config.toml with enabled=true, verify_jwt=false and exact entrypoint, while retaining independent x-powerhouse-token validation. Include a regression to block future omission. Avoid any second client-side paid request for task 40101, retain numeric diagnosis and partial HTTP 207. Only task 40102 may return independently observed zero.
